findings.explanation: Motion-alert volume depends on activity in view, not on night-mode or low-light image quality; the proxy cannot show effectiveness and no baseline or peer comparison is computed.
findings.quote: bucket motion alerts by hour-of-day to spot cameras whose night-mode behaviour is anomalous
findings.suggested_fix: Describe it as a motion-alert volume profile by time of day per camera, and state that it is not an image-quality measure.

findings.suggested_fix: Say the search returns motion alert counts per camera for night, evening, morning and day bands, and name meraki:webhook / meraki:webhooklogs:api.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Title claims night-mode effectiveness and low-light performance, which the TA does not expose and the SPL does not measure.
alertType="motionAlert" looks like a guessed value; confirm against the Meraki webhook payload (alertTypeId motion_alert may be the only working match).

summary: The title promises night-mode effectiveness and low-light quality, while the SPL only counts motion alerts per time-of-day band. The description's thresholds cover every hour and placeholder sourcetypes remain.
